pr_title: Add a MongoDB connector to the exporting engine
pr_body:
#### Summary
Implement a Prometheus Remote Write exporting connector as a part of the backends refactoring project #6762.

No need to check code in the first commit "Copy files from the MongoDB backend".

Closes #7176

##### Component Name
backends, exporting engine

##### Test Plan
`exporting.conf`:
```
[mongodb:instance8]
enabled = yes
destination = mongodb://localhost
database = netdata
collection = instance8
data source = average
update every = 2
send charts matching = system.processes

[mongodb:instance9]
enabled = yes
destination = mongodb://localhost
database = netdata
collection = instance9
data source = as collected
update every = 2
send charts matching = system.cpu
```
Run a MongoDB container: `docker run -p 27017:27017 --name mongo -d mongo`
Run the CLI:
```
docker exec -it mongo bash
mongo
```
CLI commands:
```
use <database>
db.<collection>.count()
db.<collection>.find()
db.<collection>.find().skip(db.<collection>.count() - 10)
db.<collection>.drop()
```

issue_context.title: Implement MongoDB exporting connector
issue_context.body:
##### Feature idea summary

* Code already exists in the backend that can export to MongoDB.
* Testing client - MongoDB docker image.
* Code currently has poor structure - intertwined with the existing backends.
* Sits on top of MongoDB C driver - unknown how to overcome blocking behavior of the driver.
* Similar in complexity to the Prometheus remote write exporter.
* Binary protocol rather than text

##### Expected behavior

* Reviewer will require to run a MongoDB docker container to test against.
* Note for the reviewer - the threading/locking should be standard for the exporting engine, may need to read the config reading code.

review_comments: You called the same function two times, I believe you wanted to test `socket_timeout` here.
